name: deposit
description: Agent that answers questions about deposit accounts

skills.name: Get Balance
skills.description: Get the balance of an account
examples: Give me the balance of my vacation account
What's the current balance of my primary account?

skills.name: Check Minimum Balance
skills.description: Returns 1 if the sum of all deposit account balances is greater than the provided value, otherwise 0.
examples: Is the total balance greater than $5000?
